acceptance.heading: Acceptance criteria
acceptance.text:
- [ ] The blocked-before-dispatch message names `XYZ_ARCHIVE_ROOT` first when the blocked paths are transcripts.
- [ ] The message includes a runnable export line, not just the variable name.
- [ ] `marathon.sh --help` distinguishes when to use `XYZ_ARCHIVE_ROOT` vs `--target-root`.
- [ ] A test pins the remedy text against the transcript-blocked case.

label: draft; preflight and independent plan QA outstanding

scope.heading: frontmatter goal
scope.text: An operator or agent that hits the blocked-before-dispatch refusal on a repo which deliberately ignores relay-system/ is pointed at XYZ_ARCHIVE_ROOT first, with a runnable export line, instead of being steered into --target-root and failing a second time.

title: marathon-drive's blocked-before-dispatch refusal omits XYZ_ARCHIVE_ROOT, the remedy that actually fits
